firm_data.firm_description: RoseWaldorf represents multi-national companies, including manufacturers, distributors, and other businesses, with a special focus on representing the automotive industry in product warranty and lemon law matters. With offices on the East and West Coasts, RoseWaldorf has nationwide reach with a singular mission—defending product warranties.
notable_facts: The firm's lawyers are all multi-state licensed to best serve their clients efficiently in high-volume litigation efforts.
RoseWaldorf regularly represents clients in 21 states.
The firm has handled appeals in the highest courts of six states, as well as numerous intermediate appellate courts in a number of jurisdictions.

founders.name: Keith B. Rose
